name: A Gift for the Alliance Leader

steps.name: A Gift for the Alliance Leader (1)
steps.objective: First talk to [Ren] in 「Avalon」. Defeat [Zisk Plains Algea] in 「Zisk Plains」 to obtain <Zisk Blueberries>, and defeat [Narke of Despair] in 「Icicle Prison」 to obtain <Kali Blueberries>. Then return to [Ren] in 「Avalon」.

lines.text: (In a quiet alley of Avalon, Ren warily watches a figure obscured by drifting sand.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ren, it's me. %s.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer. I sensed a powerful presence and went on guard for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Are you on patrol?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes. Frozen is inspecting the inner part of Avalon, and I'm watching this side. What brings you here, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I wanted to see Avalon again.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I see. I was a little disappointed we couldn't share a meal. Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it did. I've come back to Avalon, but there's really nothing here, is there?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Even so, we can't know what might happen, so we have to be careful. Oh, Adventurer, there's something I wanted to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Something serious?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: No, nothing serious. Lady Medea gave me a recipe for traditional Kali liquor, but I need your help to make it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You think I can make it?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Lady Medea wanted to give some to my master as a gift, but she used up so much power during recent events that she can't make it herself.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: So she gave me the recipe and asked me to make it for her... But it requires a visit to Lapier.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Could you help? I'm sorry. I'm not able to go to Lapier...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lapier... Of course. Lord Ziskad has helped me a great deal, too.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Thank you. If you make it and give it to him, I don't think Yuran will object.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does Yuran dislike Lord Ziskad drinking so much?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: She just wants him to look after his health. She's always saying things like, 'Master, if you keep drinking like that, you may leave this world before Weiss does.'

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Still, he doesn't drink as much or for as long these days. All he's done recently is drink nonstop with Lord Valdrick for about two days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Champions really are something else.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Lady Medea was concerned too, so she gave me a recipe for just one bottle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. What ingredients do we need?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Kali Blueberries and Zisk Blueberries.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: You should find them in Icicle Prison and the Zisk Plains. They're special blueberries, so they have to be gathered in the wild.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'll prepare the other ingredients. Please bring them back here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, then.

steps.name: A Gift for the Alliance Leader (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] in 「Divine Tree Lapier」 and obtain <Traditional Kali Liquor>. Then find [Ziskad] in 「Zisk Plains」.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Over here, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've brought the blueberries. But all this...
(A large tub and numerous bags of what appear to be ingredients sit in front of Ren.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It's for my master, so I wanted to make an effort. That lovely scent must be coming from your blueberries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must be. I didn't expect them to smell so strong...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Perhaps it's more noticeable because there's nothing left in Avalon. Oh, could you give me the ingredients?
(Ren accepts the blueberries and starts putting them in the large tub, then picks out a single berry.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I wonder if Tariel is still here. There's nothing left now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tariel? The goose spirit that kept chasing us so relentlessly until recently?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: As you know, %s, spirits dwell in practically everything in the world.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: In elements like fire, water, earth, and wind, in natural things like stones, flowers, and trees. Even in the chairs and plates we use at home.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: They are everywhere because they work for the sake of life. So if such a spirit harms people or other living beings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must have been corrupted by an evil power, or influenced by something stronger than itself.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Now that the evil power is gone, this place should return to normal too. And you've brought fruit filled with pure energy...

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Oh, I'm going on too long, aren't I? I want to put something I learned in the order to use while we're here. For Avalon's sake...
(Ren gently drops a blueberry into a hole she has dug and offers a prayer. As she prays, a goose's call sounds from somewhere nearby.)
Honk, honk! Honk! Honk, honk!
(A goose's head appears and disappears among the drifts of sand before emerging fully. It approaches the hole, picks up the blueberry Ren dropped, and begins shaking it.)
Honk, honk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tariel looks happy.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It must like it.
Honk, honk! Honk, honk, honk!
(Tariel keeps nodding toward Ren as if in greeting, then clutches the blueberry and runs off, vanishing from sight.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I don't know how long it will take, but if Tariel uses its power properly, delicious blueberries will grow in Avalon too.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Shall we get started, then?
(Ren adds the ingredients to the tub and stirs them with a large ladle. Before long, she pours the mixture into a large bottle.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: That's everything. Here you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Take this to the summit of Lapier and shake it for about three minutes, as though you're dancing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Is that really all I have to do?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: That's what Lady Medea's recipe says. Please trust it and try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Should I bring it back to you when it's done?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: You can take it straight to my master. And eat this if you get hungry on the way. It's ciabatta made in the Seres Order's style.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Ren. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the bread has raisins in it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But can you really make traditional Kali liquor this way? It certainly smells good...
(With a cool breeze for company, you reach Lapier's summit. The air feels distinctly purer than it does below.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air really is different here. Come to think of it, this is where I fought Requiem...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has it been that long already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, let's stop thinking about other things and shake this bottle. Like dancing, as Ren said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one's watching, right?
(No people are nearby, but several of Lapier's mystical beasts have followed the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. You lot, please pretend you didn't see this. All right, three minutes. Here goes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It really worked. The color changed! Has it aged? It seems to have...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You there, Tractus! Stop clapping! And don't copy my dance!

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I've seen Jenna. Time to head back. Oh, %s? What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lord Ziskad.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's only been a few days, but I'm glad to see you again. Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it did.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: ...I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: We will continue doing what we can here for everyone's sake.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There are still beings that threaten us all. The road ahead will grow more difficult.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: And you will continue to face great trials yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you for saying so... I hope you will believe in yourself and act for the people who believe in you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: ...And %s, take care of yourself first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember your words, Lord Ziskad.
(%s's answer leaves Ziskad briefly lost in thought.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What is that you're carrying, though? From the container, it looks as if it came from Kali...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You recognize it?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Of course I do. Traditional Kali liquor, isn't it? They served it to me when I visited Kali long ago.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Did Medea send this? She said what I drank then was the last of it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain to Ziskad how the liquor was made.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea had it all planned. Giving the recipe to Ren...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: She must have asked Ren in the hope that new fruits of hope would grow in Avalon too.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Here, hand it over.
(Ziskad cannot hide his delight as he accepts the traditional Kali liquor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't expect you to be so pleased...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That's how precious it is. Rare fruit and long aging give it a deep flavor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it needs aging, didn't we make this much too quickly?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I suspect she used a little shortcut. Normally, they age it in the village...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: If it was made using Lapier's energy, she probably spoke with Lady Iris about it as well.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: A lovely aroma. I can't keep something this good to myself... Will you join me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, thank you. It's a gift for you, Lord Ziskad. You're welcome to enjoy it yourself.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Shall I, then?
(No sooner has he spoken than Ziskad pulls a cup from inside his clothes and fills it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, why did you have a cup in there?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Haha, pretend you didn't see that. Ah, wonderful. I can't be the only one to enjoy something this good. We should share it with everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The liquor?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Not only the liquor. We have much to do together with the Kali tribe. Medea feels the same.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The Kali and the other peoples of Eastland must work together if we are to move toward a better future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Very good indeed. Hehe... How long I've waited for this day... Ah...
(Ziskad is suddenly overcome with emotion.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: How long has it been since I felt this way...? So very long... Tell me... Are you busy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I have time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Nothing much. I'd like to tell you about my past. I feel I can share that story with you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear it.
(Grateful for %s's response, Ziskad gathers wood and lights a fire. As he finishes, the fragrance of the liquor in his cup stirs memories of the past.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: When was it that I went to Kali Village...? I remember the first time I met Medea.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, hahaha. She looked at me as though she'd never met such a person in her life.
(Ziskad's story continues late into the night over the Zisk Plains. With each passing hour, the trust and faith between the two grow deeper.)
